name: María Elena García Navarro
title: Principal Product Manager
summary: Principal Product Manager with 12+ years of experience leading B2B and platform products across fintech, SaaS, and digital marketplaces. Known for turning complex business goals into clear product strategy, driving cross-functional execution, and delivering measurable growth in conversion, retention, and revenue.

Directed a 9-person cross-functional squad across engineering, design, risk, and operations, reducing checkout abandonment by 17%.

Owned quarterly OKRs and portfolio prioritization, improving roadmap predictability by 30%.
Scaled marketplace features for partner merchants, contributing to a 22% increase in repeat order rate.
Introduced experimentation frameworks that improved conversion on key purchase flows by 11%.
Partnered with data and operations teams to reduce support tickets related to order issues by 19%.
Managed a product backlog spanning logistics, consumer, and merchant experiences in a fast-paced growth environment.
Led digital banking initiatives for retail customers, growing mobile active users by 26% over two years.
Delivered a redesigned account-opening funnel that improved completion rates by 14%.
Worked closely with compliance and legal teams to launch regulated features on schedule and without audit findings.
Built business cases and dashboards to support executive decision-making on product investments.
Supported development of FX and international payments products for SME clients across Europe.
Helped define customer journeys and requirements that reduced manual processing steps by 25%.
Tracked feature adoption and funnel metrics to prioritize enhancements with the highest commercial impact.
